tables.name: entries
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE `entries` (`id` varchar(255), `name` varchar(255) not null, `type` varchar(255) default '', `sortOrder` integer default '0', `imgUrl` varchar(255) default '', `data` text default '{}', `folderId` varchar(255) not null default '', primary key (`id`))

tables.name: folders
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE `folders` (`id` varchar(255), `name` varchar(255) not null, `parent` varchar(255) not null default '', `color` varchar(255) not null default '', `sorting` varchar(255) not null default 'm', `hubLogoUrl` varchar(255) not null default '', `hubBackground` varchar(255) not null default '', primary key (`id`))
